bibliographic.title: One last chance
bibliographic.author: Remko
bibliographic.description:
You are told that you have little time left. However, you may change one choice in your life. What will you change? And does that help?

You may want to try a few playthroughs, since there are a few different pathways (including one way to try to see death again). Obviously, this is just a small prototype, since it is such a small game.

This is my entry for the Neo-Twiny game jam. Where I saw a number of mini escape room games, I wondered whether I could make a more existential thingie.

Feedback is very much appreciated! This is my first Twine game published here, so I'm curious as to what you think of this. That might just include saying "this cannot be done in 500 words" ;-).
